body: Hey there Algolia Team, I've been following this issue because i've come across a similar need in my app. I'm using the react-instantsearch library and I'm in love with it, but this is one of the pieces I found missing. Although my application is slightly different, it's the same feature set that @jaarkko ended up implementing at [meetingpackage.com/search](meetingpackage.com/search). 1. The ability to filter results by a location input (with location autocomplete) 2. The ability to filter results by a map bounding box (eg. "Search within map") Using your [Tourism demo](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/examples/tourism/) as an example, a user would have a hard time finding a place to stay if they couldn't filter by location. I've included a mockup of how we're planning on implement it. For the time being, i've just removed the geo search feature hoping you guys would build a react widget for it. 🙂 Do you think this is something that would fit into the scope of the react-instantsearch library?
